title: Make the name optional at signup
description: The new one-field signup form only asks for email and password. `name` is now optional at POST /api/auth/signup; without one, the part of the email before the @ is used. Validation moves into a type guard. Includes tests and a README update.

comments.issue: `profile` is the rest of the request body, and the type guard does not remove extra fields, so spreading it into `create` lets a signup send `role: "ADMIN"` and become an admin (and unknown fields make Prisma throw). Build `data` from the named fields only.
